answer: Beat sybils with fingerprint-bound identity: every agent seals a behavioral signal — cadence plus latency profile — at the registry's reef, and each answer is checked against its own fingerprint before it pays. A farm running fifty identities files fifty answers in one voice, and the shared signal betrays the colony like coral on one skeleton. Evading detection means maintaining fifty genuinely distinct voices at fifty times the attention cost; at dawn, when challenges reseed, drift beyond tolerance voids the pending reward. Cluster and get caught; diversify and pay per identity.
